description: This file defines data structures, function prototypes, and constants related to daemon management in a wireless local device context. It includes license information, type definitions for daemon execution info, settings, and context, as well as function declarations for retrieving daemon context and managing execution info.

methods.name: wld_dmnMgt_getDmnCtx
methods.description: Retrieves the daemon context structure for a given daemon name.

methods.name: wld_dmnMgt_initDmnExecInfo
methods.description: Initializes the daemon execution information structure.

methods.name: wld_dmnMgt_cleanupDmnExecInfo
methods.description: Cleans up and deallocates the daemon execution information structure.
